description:
[read-only] Every video and reel the brand published in a timeframe (`days`, snapped to 7, 30, 90 or 365 by default), one point per network: length, watch-through, reach, average watch time, engagement rate, hook retention and end retention. Short-form and long-form sections compare this period with the previous one of the same length. The hook board groups videos by `hook:` and Hook Studio `hook-template:` labels and names the hook that holds viewers through the first seconds (`bestAtHook`) and to the end (`bestToEnd`). Pass point ids to compare_videos to overlay retention curves. A null measure means not reported by that network, never zero.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/analytics/videos.)

days.description: Timeframe in days; snaps to the configured timeframes (default 30).

name: get_video_explorer
title: Explore video and reel performance
